standard_prerequisites.name: The openness on topological spaces of a flat morphism of finite presentation of schemes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 5947-5948) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives openness for the induced morphism between the presenting schemes.

core_obligations: Choose presentations: the proof takes smooth surjective morphisms from schemes onto the target and onto the fibre product of the source with that cover, so that the induced morphism of schemes is flat and locally of finite presentation (proof lines 5943-5946)
Openness of the resulting map of schemes: by the corresponding statement for schemes that morphism is open on topological spaces (proof lines 5947-5948)

Descend to the stacks: the map from the cover of the target is open and the map from the cover of the source is surjective, so elementary topology gives openness of the map between the spaces of the stacks (proof lines 5949-5952)
proof_roadmap: 取概型 V 满光滑映到 Y、U 满光滑映到 V ×_Y X，则 U → V 平坦且局部有限表现，由概型层面的引理在拓扑空间上开。
又 |V| → |Y| 开、|U| → |X| 满，由初等拓扑即得 |X| → |Y| 开。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a flat morphism of finite presentation of algebraic stacks induces an open map on topological spaces (author lemma at source lines 5936-5940, label lemma-fppf-open). The proof (source lines 5942-5953) chooses smooth presentations of both stacks, applies the corresponding statement for schemes to the induced flat morphism of finite presentation, and combines the openness and surjectivity of the maps from the presentations by elementary topology (proof lines 5943-5952). The final passage between the presentations is the content. H2.
